title: hub: refuse §4.7-invalid standalone AppDataUpdate proposals
description: Per decision mimid-1wgh.4.65: a member holding an invalid stored AppDataUpdate cannot commit that epoch, and the hub forces cached proposals into the next Commit (protocol-06 §3.5). So the hub must refuse, on arrival, a standalone AppDataUpdate proposal that breaks mls-extensions-10 §4.7 (an unknown component; a remove of absent data; two removes, or a remove plus an update, for one id across the cached proposals). Regression test first, with input from an independent implementation.
